## Intent

One paragraph describing the user or system outcome.

## In scope

- Explicit behavior.

## Out of scope

- Explicit exclusions.

## User stories or actors

- As a ..., I can ..., so that ...

## Data and state

Models, fields, states, constraints, or frontend state ownership.

## API or UI contract

## Authorization and security

Exact roles, record visibility, rate limit, audit, and sensitive-data requirements.

## Services/selectors or feature flow

Named functions and explicit flow. No class frameworks.

## Errors and edge cases

Stable error codes and recovery behavior.

## Localization and accessibility

Translation, date, RTL, and accessibility expectations.

- Test name or behavior.
